scripts.build:packages: node scripts/prepare-tool-directories.mjs && tsc -b packages/core/tsconfig.node.json packages/ui/tsconfig.json site/tsconfig.registry.json && node scripts/sync-ui-assets.mjs
scripts.watch:packages: concurrently --kill-others --names types,styles "tsc -b packages/core/tsconfig.node.json packages/ui/tsconfig.json site/tsconfig.registry.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "node scripts/sync-ui-assets.mjs --watch"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:packages && tsc -b server/tsconfig.json && node scripts/check-types.mjs tools && pnpm --filter @foliohaven/studio typecheck && node scripts/check-site-types.mjs
scripts.test: pnpm run build:packages && vitest run --project unit
scripts.test:integration: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @foliohaven/server build && vitest run --project integration
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @foliohaven/server build && playwright test
scripts.build: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @foliohaven/server build && node scripts/build.mjs
scripts.preview: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @foliohaven/server build && node scripts/preview.mjs
scripts.validate:content: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @foliohaven/server build && node scripts/validate-content.mjs
